meaning:
φόβητρον (LTr., WH, -θρον), -ου, τό
(φοβέω), [in LXX: Isa.19:17 (חָגָא) * ;]
that which causes fright, a terror: pl. (as always, exc.Isa, l.with), Luk.21:11 (Hipp., Plat.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
